# .tekton/ — Auto-Generated Files

These pipeline files are generated by the **Product Management Tool (PMT)**.
Manual edits will be overwritten on the next regeneration.

To make changes, update the PMC configs and re-run PMT:
- **Configs:** https://github.com/red-hat-data-services/aipcc-product-management-configs
- **PMT:** https://github.com/opendatahub-io/product-management-tool
